# elections

> A unified Python interface to multiple election data sources from around the world.


## Pages in this subsection

- [elections](elections.html.md): Election Data Package
- [elections.democracy_works](elections.democracy_works.html.md): Democracy Works Elections API Data Source
- [elections.google_civic](elections.google_civic.html.md): Google Civic Information API Data Source
- [elections.ipu_parline](elections.ipu_parline.html.md): IPU Parline - Inter-Parliamentary Union Data Source
- [elections.nytimes](elections.nytimes.html.md): New York Times Election Data Source
- [elections.openfec](elections.openfec.html.md): OpenFEC - Federal Election Commission Data Source
